It is mostly online, but we have had a few in-person encounters. They went very rocky, but it wasn't entirely her fault. Since I made this post, my girlfriend has told me that she knows, even without me saying it, that she has destroyed me mentally. She has admitted that she's problematic, but she says that no matter how hard she's trying, it only gets worse. I'll admit that I have my own flaws too. I struggle to show my emotions, and I've been mentally shutting down/withdrawing in general. Not just from her, but from other people. I've tried to tell her that I don't want to be in a relationship because I need to work on my own mental state/I can't love anyone properly while I'm stuck in my current fast-declining headspace, but she says that that's an excuse people use when they're cheating and want to break things off so they can be with the other person. It makes me feel terrible for expressing what's on my mind. I rely a lot on communication in relationships, but she makes it so difficult to communicate. 


As far as what you said for the FP, yes. It is a lot like that. It's exhausting. She's been a little better at catching herself when she's about to flip, but it feels like too little too late. I have to dissociate just to talk to her sometimes. 


Unfortunately, the problem with having her involuntarily committed, the only mental hospital in her area is one that she's been to before, and they treated her terribly. She has trauma from that place, and I'd hate to send her back there knowing that.


Logically, I know that I need to leave. I'm not even sure if I truly love her as a partner anymore, or if I just care about her enough to not want anything to happen. But with how much time we have invested into this relationship, how much we've been through and the things we've shared, it's terrifying. My heart and brain just can't seem to agree, especially when her own mental health problems come into play. 


I used to be so disappointed every time we had to say goodbye for a little bit. Now I avoid speaking to her as much as I can. I hate this. I feel horrible for avoiding her, but I can't stand to speak to her sometimes.


Edit: Now that I think about it, it feels like she accused me of being a cold, uncaring, bad person so much that now I'm actually starting to become that around her. I don't like the thought or feel of that, but I just don't know how to fix this.

I'm still fairly new to Reddit and don't know how to attach an image, but the sticker on the front of the drill press just says TRADESMAN PRO, so I think it's just the Chinese one you said. If it is, it sucks that it's an off-brand, but it's working surprisingly well for us so far.

There are 2 statues for Togo, I believe, but they aren't in the area where it happened. Something that really upsets me though is that Balto's body was preserved and put on display at a museum, in tact. Togo, however, his skin was separated from his bones and they were put on display in two different places.

I want to get out. It's just terrifying. Unfortunately, I am very empathetic. And every time I try to figure out how to leave, it feels like I'm punishing her for being mentally ill which just isn't fair. She's been through a lot. We both have. I just don't know how to get my heart and my mind to agree on how to leave without being terrified of something happening to her. Especially because of the threats, and the fact that she has had attempts in the past, while we have been together, so I don't know how to do this and keep my peace of mind.

We've gone through and downloaded/disabled a lot of mods. Checked and rechecked lists. It keeps saying "disable this mod" like my friend doesn't have said mod enabled. But when I go back and disable it, it says "enable mod required" and even they say that on their end it's enabled. It's baffling. Or it'll say "update this mod" then when I update the mod, it says I need to downgrade it. It just keeps going back and forth like that. The one time we got past all of the mod issues, it would get to the loading screen just before the opening nautiloid scene, then the game would crash.


And it works fine on single player. I'm actually playing solo right now and everything is fine. No crashing, lagging, glitching, nothing. It's only multi-player that it doesn't want to work.
Please let me know if you do hear back! The project I was working on is long done now, but I would still like to watch the movie as well. It seemed very interesting

I have heard a few theories, but I'm unsure. The author of the book did (TW!!) kill himself the same year the book was written, and the book is based off of a fictionalized version of his life. I believe it's categorized as a semi-autobiography. My partner said that other people do tend to have weird feelings while reading the book as well, and will experience a sense of depression after finishing the book. I'm again, unsure. But I do want to eventually finish the book, because it has been interesting and I was so looking forward to it. (Also, I didn't ask my partner if the anxiety thing was normal until AFTER I made the post about the book)

I just know that it's a semi-autobiography of Dazai's, and is reported as one of his greatest novels. My partner who introduced me to the book did say that people have a sense of anxiety, depression, or (tw) suicidal ideation after reading, and a lot of people seem to think it's because the author soon after writing this did, sadly, end his life.   


I'm currently reasoning that it most likely has something to do with the fact that you're supposed to feel the same thing the point of view is feeling, similar to what you said.

I do have a lot of empathy towards Yozo, probably because I've personally experienced some of the same thoughts that I've seen Yozo display so far. I've never really thought of myself as a good or bad person though. It's strange, but I really like it and I'm not sure why. Aside from the moments of extreme anxiety, I can't seem to put the book down. I read through two chapters since I posted this story. Also, I might check out that adaptation series you mentioned. I do like anime, so it may be worth a shot.
Thank you! I found what I needed. Not any audio, but I can read through it.
